alerts.name: Short sells without 331=1 where Bloomberg says A
alerts.description: Today's short sell orders (side = sellshort), in every market, whose fixmsg does not carry 331=1, and whose stock has DYNAMIC_SHORT_SALE_CODE_RT = A on Bloomberg (B-PIPE). Checked every 5 minutes, 08:00-18:00 Hong Kong time; it notifies when an order joins or leaves the list.

steps.name: orders
steps.raw_q: {[d] t:select date,id_server,id_target,sym,trader,side,size,algo from target where date=d, side=`sellshort, not fixmsg like "*331=1*"; m:`TW`JP!`TT`JT; update bbg:{[m;s] p:"." vs string s; x:`$last p; x:x^m x; `$(first p)," ",(string x)," Equity"}[m] each sym from t}[.z.D]
steps.note: Today's sellshort rows in target whose fixmsg has no 331=1; bbg = the Bloomberg ticker from the suffix (7203.JP -> 7203 JT Equity, 2330.TW -> 2330 TT Equity)

steps.name: ssc
steps.note: The dynamic short sale code, asked at every check (it can change during the day)

steps.name: flagged
steps.note: Only the rows whose code is A
